source: Insgesamt seien vier Verkehrsschauen durchgeführt worden, auch ein Kreisverkehr wurde angedacht, allerdings wegen der Enge in dem Kreuzungsbereich Sulzbachweg/Kirchstraße wieder verworfen.
reference: A total of four road safety inspections were carried out and a roundabout was also considered, however, this idea was rejected on account of the narrowness of the Sulzbachweg/Kirchstrasse junctions.
hypothesis: In total, four traffic checks were carried out, including a roundabout, which was also considered, but was rejected again because of the narrowness of the Sulzbachweg/Kirchstraße junction.

source: Es wurde laut Arnold bei der Standortwahl der Ampelmasten zuvor alles ausgetestet: "Mittels eines extra für uns mit besonders langen Holzstämmen beladener Transporter haben wir ausgestestet, ob diese Fahrzeuge aus dem Sulzbachweg auf die B 33 ausfahren können, ohne den Ampelmasten umzuknicken".
reference: According to Arnold, every possible test was carried out prior to the selection of the location for the traffic light posts: "Using a goods vehicle loaded with particularly long tree trunks, we also tested whether such vehicles could access the B 33 from the Sulzbachweg without knocking over the traffic light posts".
hypothesis: According to Arnold , the location of the traffic lights was chosen after a thorough testing process: "Using a special transporter loaded with particularly long wooden poles, we tested the traffic lights to see if they could be moved from the Sulzbachweg to the B 33 without the traffic lights bending."

source: Die rund 15 000 Euro teure Ampelanlage selbst ist das "modernste, was es derzeit auf dem Markt gibt", erläuterte Arnold.
reference: The traffic light system itself, which cost around EUR 15,000, is the "most modern system that is currently available on the market," explained Arnold.
hypothesis: The approximately 15,000 euros worth of traffic lights themselves are the "most modern on the market at the moment," explained Arnold.

source: Die Anlage ist mit farbigen LEDs ausgestattet, die so kräftig leuchten, dass die Lichter von den Autofahrern beispielsweise auch bei tiefstehender Sonne gut zu erkennen sind.
reference: The system is fitted with coloured LEDs, which are bright enough that drivers can easily see the lights, even when the sun is low in the sky.
hypothesis: The plant is equipped with colored LEDs that shine so brightly that they can be seen from cars even when the sun is low in the sky.

source: Und sparsam ist sie auch: Die älteren Lichtanlagen verbrauchen etwa 100 Watt, die neuen gerade mal acht Watt.
reference: And they are also energy-efficient: The older light systems consume around 100 Watts, with the new ones consuming just eight.
hypothesis: And it is also economical: the older lighting systems consume around 100 watts, while the new ones consume just eight.

source: Pro Fahrtrichtung gibt es drei Lichtanlagen.
reference: There are three sets of lights per direction of travel.
hypothesis: There are three lighting systems per direction of travel.

source: Arnold erklärte die Technik der neuen Anlage: Diese ist mit zwei Radarsensoren ausgestattet.
reference: Arnold explained the technology used by the new system: It is fitted with two radar sensors.
hypothesis: Arnold explained the technology of the new plant: This is equipped with two radar sensors, which are used to detect the position of the fruit.

source: Drückt der Fußgänger den Ampelknopf, testet der obere Radarsensor die Verkehrslage.
reference: If the pedestrian presses the button at the traffic lights, the top radar sensor checks the traffic status.
hypothesis: If the pedestrian presses the button, the upper sensor tests the traffic situation.

source: Ist die Straße frei, kommt unmittelbar Grün für den Fußgänger, wenn nicht, dauert es etwa 15 Sekunden.
reference: If the street is clear, the pedestrian obtains a green light immediately, if not, there is a delay of around 15 seconds.
hypothesis: Is the road clear, then there is an immediate green light for the pedestrian, if not, it takes about 15 seconds.

source: Ein weiteres Radarsensor prüft, ob die Grünphase für den Fußgänger beendet werden kann.
reference: An additional radar sensor checks whether the green phase for the pedestrian can be ended.
hypothesis: Another radar sensor checks whether the green phase is over for the pedestrian.

source: "Sollte eine Gruppe oder gehbehinderte Menschen über die Straße gehen, wird die Grünphase verlängert, es kommt also jeder sicher über die Fahrbahn", erklärte Arnold.
reference: "If a group of people or if disabled persons are crossing the street, the green phase is extended, thus ensuring that everyone gets safely across the street," explained Arnold.
hypothesis: "If a group or disabled people are crossing the road, the green phase is extended, so it is safe for everyone to cross the road." explained Arnold.

source: Natürlich müsse der Autofahrer hier als Partner mitdenken und die Fahrbahn beobachten.
reference: Of course, drivers must also play their part and keep their eyes on the road.
hypothesis: Of course, the driver must be a partner in this and keep an eye on the road.

source: Dies war gestern nicht der Fall: Kaum zeigte die Ampel für Fußgänger grün, rauschte ein Oberklasse-Fahrzeug durch - bei leuchtendem Rot.
reference: Yesterday this was not the case: The light had barely turned green for pedestrians when a luxury vehicle sped through on a red light.
hypothesis: This was not the case yesterday: Hardly had the pedestrian light turned green, a car from the upper class raced through the intersection - with the red light still on.

source: Josef Winkler schreibt sich seit mehr als 30 Jahren die Nöte seiner Kindheit und Jugend von der Seele.
reference: For more than 30 years, Josef Winkler has been writing from the heart, telling of the hardships of his childhood and youth.
hypothesis: Josef Winkler writes about the troubles of his childhood and youth for more than 30 years from the bottom of his heart.

source: Die Katastrophen seiner katholischen Dorfkindheit - die Sprachlosigkeit, der Hang zu roher Gewalt und stumpfer Sexualität, die Enge und Freudlosigkeit - hat der Kärntner Dichter vielfach beschrieben.
reference: The catastrophes of his Catholic village upbringing - the speechlessness, his tendency towards brute force and dulled sexuality, the confinement and lack of joy - all of this has been described many times by the Kaernten-born poet.
hypothesis: The catastrophes of his Catholic village childhood - the speechlessness, the propensity for raw violence, the stupid sexuality, the narrowness and joylessness of it all - have been described many times by the Carinthian poet.

source: Bekannt ist der Büchner-Preisträger vor allem als Prosaautor, Theatertexte sind in seinem Werk rar.
reference: The Büchner prizewinner is known primarily as a writer of prose, with theatre texts something of a rarity for him.
hypothesis: The Büchner Prize winner is known above all for his prose, and theater texts are rare in his work.

source: Collage aus Prosatexten Gerhard Fresacher stellt für seine Aufführung "Wetterleuchten auf der Zungenspitze", die nun in der Garage X am Petersplatz zu sehen ist, daher eine Collage aus Prosatexten zusammen.
reference: In a collage of prose texts For his performance piece, "Wetterleuchten auf der Zungenspitze" (Summer lightning on the tip of your tongue), which can now be seen in Garage X on Petersplatz, Gerhard Fresacher ,creates a collage of prose texts.
hypothesis: Collage of prose texts Gerhard Fresacher presents his performance "Wetterleuchten auf der Zungenspitze" (Weather flashes on the tip of the tongue), which is now being performed in the Garage X at Petersplatz , with a collage of prose texts .

source: Der Theatermacher verbindet etwa Elemente aus dem autobiografisch geprägten Roman "Der Leibeigene" (1987) mit Prosaminiaturen aus "Leichnam, seine Familie belauernd" (2003).
reference: The theatre producer has thus combined elements from the autobiographically inspired novel "Der Leibeigene" (1987) [The Bondsman] featuring prose miniatures from "Leichnam, seine Familie belauernd" (2003) [Corpse, stalking his family].
hypothesis: The theatre maker combines about elements from the autobiographical novel "Der Leibeigene" (1987) with prose miniatures from "Leichnam, seine Familie und and" (2003).

source: Auf der weitgehend leergeräumten Bühne - wichtiges Requisit: ein zerknautschtes Sofa, auf dem andeutungsweise kopuliert und masturbiert wird - hangelt sich das achtköpfige Ensemble durch das Textmaterial.
reference: On the predominantly empty stage - with one important requirement: a crumpled sofa, on which cast members allude to copulating and masturbating - the eight-person ensemble work their way through the text material.
hypothesis: On the largely empty stage, an important prop: a battered sofa, on which a hint of copulation takes place and masturbation is hinted at - the eight-member ensemble shuffles through the text material.

source: Dabei scheint Regisseur Fresacher dem Text wenig zu vertrauen.
reference: However, Director Fresacher seems to have little trust in the text.
hypothesis: In this case, director Fresacher seems to have little faith in the text.

source: Die 70-minütige Performance übertüncht die Vorlage mit einer Fülle an Regieeinfällen, bekannt aus dem Repertoire postdramatischer Spielformen.
reference: The 70-minute performance glosses over the script with a host of director's additions, well-known from the repertoire of post-dramatic theatrical styles.
hypothesis: The 70-minute performance obscures the source material with a plethora of directorial flourishes, familiar from the repertoire of post-dramatic forms of play.

source: Vor allem die Schauspielerinnen kommen bei den mitunter etwas fragwürdigen szenischen Umsetzungen dran.
reference: In particular, the actresses play a major role in the sometimes rather dubious staging.
hypothesis: Above all, the actresses are the ones who suffer from the sometimes questionable staging.

source: Sie werden hart angefasst, mit dem Kopf unter Wasser getaucht, mit ihren Abendroben an die Wand getackert.
reference: They are manhandled, their heads held under water, tacked to the wall by their evening gowns.
hypothesis: They are grabbed hard, submerged under water, and scratched against the wall with their evening dresses.

source: Eingezwängt in Zellophan oder Mieder, staksen sie auf gefährlich hohen Stöckeln durch die Inszenierung, entweder monologisieren sie lautstark oder liegen völlig verstummt auf dem Bühnenboden.
reference: Wrapped in cellophane or in girdles, they stumble on dangerously high heels across the set, either delivering monologues at the top of their voices or lying completely silent on the stage.
hypothesis: Squeezed into cellophane or corsets, they tottered on dangerously high heels through the production, either monologuing loudly or lying completely still on the floor.
